entries.title: Search
entries.text: Puts the cursor in the search bar. Type and matches come up letter by letter. Ctrl+K or / does the same.

entries.title: Globe or gear
entries.text: The button at the start of the bar: globe searches everything, gear searches settings only.

entries.title: Matching
entries.text: How typed text is matched: words in any order, word starts, the exact phrase, or a regular expression.

entries.title: AI assistance
entries.text: Ranks results with your local Llama. Used only when an Ollama connection exists and this is on; otherwise the bar's own matching does everything.

entries.title: Bars
entries.text: Add more search bars to the banner or a toolbar, each with its own view and scope. Remove them here.
